name: Start Ajovy (30-day injectable)
clinician_task: Ask your clinician about starting Ajovy, a 30-day injectable. Do not start it on your own.

name: Taper verapamil
clinician_task: Ask your clinician about tapering verapamil. Do not stop or change it on your own.

name: Reduce Luvox from 150 mg to 100 mg
clinician_task: Ask your clinician about reducing Luvox from 150 mg to 100 mg. Do not change this dose on your own.

name: Urine culture to rule out a cryptic UTI
clinician_task: Ask your clinician for a urine culture to look for a cryptic UTI.

name: Stop morning magnesium threonate
side_effect_notes: Potential change: stop morning magnesium threonate. Do this on your own only if a clinician did not prescribe it.

name: No yogurt — low-histamine diet again
side_effect_notes: Potential change: stop yogurt and return to a low-histamine diet.

name: Sleep study
clinician_task: Ask your clinician about a sleep study.

name: Increase Vyvanse
clinician_task: Ask your clinician about increasing Vyvanse. Do not change the dose on your own.

name: Nasal irrigation / Afrin
clinician_task: Ask your clinician before using Afrin. Do not start it on your own. Nasal irrigation is listed with it.

name: Melatonin circadian reset for an earlier bedtime
side_effect_notes: Potential change: use melatonin to shift toward an earlier bedtime. No dose is stored here.

name: More outdoor time, walking, and gentle movement
side_effect_notes: Potential change: more outdoor time, walking, and gentle movement to prevent deconditioning and set circadian rhythms.

name: Retest vitamins, thyroid, and autoimmune panels, especially Sjögren's
clinician_task: Ask your clinician to retest vitamins, thyroid, and autoimmune panels, especially Sjögren's.

name: GLP-1
clinician_task: Ask your clinician about a GLP-1 medicine. Do not start it on your own.

name: Eye recheck — pursue more BVD treatment
clinician_task: Ask for an eye recheck and whether to pursue more binocular-vision treatment.
hypothesis_titles: Binocular vision dysfunction / ocular motor problem

name: Over-the-counter sleep apnea interventions
side_effect_notes: Potential non-prescription ideas. This is not a substitute for a sleep study or a prescribed treatment.

name: Upgrade Apple Watch and/or Oura Ring
side_effect_notes: For better sleep apnea detection, and more data, especially temperature, for tracking circadian rhythm changes.

name: Migraine, sensory, and burnout recovery
side_effect_notes: Dim lights, low sound, and low demand.
